device.type: lumped-element flux-pumped JPA (3-wave mixing, pump ≈ 2 f_r)
device.fabrication: single-step optical lithography, Manhattan JJ (to be confirmed)
device.structure: signal port - IDT capacitor - SQUID; pump/flux line to pump port

wiring.controller: QM OPX+ con1 + Octave oct1 (cluster OPXplus_3, 10.21.30.201:9593); settings in experiments/opx_common.py SETUP
wiring.readout_drive: Octave RF out 1 (OPX AO1/AO2) -> signal input line
wiring.readout_receive: output chain -> Octave RF in 1 (OPX AI1/AI2)
wiring.pump_source: Octave RF out 2 (OPX AO3/AO4) -> pump port via bias tee (RF side)
wiring.dc_bias_source: OPX+ AO5 DC offset (|V| <= 0.5 V into 50 ohm)
wiring.dc_bias_path: pump port via bias tee (DC side) (to be confirmed)
wiring.notes: Since 2026-10-13 everything is on the OPX+/Octave; VNA, PSG and DC205 are disconnected. flux_calibration voltages refer to the OPX+ AO5 offset.

circuit.notes: Do not use Mutus 2013 values (4.2 pF / 24 pH / 68 pH) as defaults; they are not this chip's design values.

reference_expectations.notes: From NCU theses/talks for similar LJPAs, NOT measured on this chip

history.change: signal input line 50 dB, pump line 20 dB total attenuation
wiring moved to OPX+ / Octave (readout RF out1 / RF in1, pump RF out2, flux AO5); VNA, PSG, DC205 disconnected
